tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 12 (UX polish, onboarding & the update flow) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 12) and spec.md (UI & UX; Error Handling & Updates) first. Reuse existing layers: src/lib/db/ (models + Repositories, BackupData-shaped data), src/stores/ (all domain stores + initializeStores; useAuthStore holds `repositories`), src/lib/currency/, src/routes.tsx + src/components/Layout.tsx (nav). vite-plugin-pwa is configured with registerType 'prompt' from Phase 0.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/sample/** (create), src/lib/shortcuts/** (create), src/components/onboarding/** + src/components/shortcuts/** + src/components/pwa/** (create), src/App.tsx (mount the shortcuts handler + the PWA update prompt — do not restructure the router), src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (add first-run onboarding), and src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (add load/clear sample data — keep the existing sections). Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, the stores, routes.tsx, Layout.tsx, other pages, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push. (Read the stores; do not edit them — call their existing actions/load().)

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): buildSampleData() returns a well-formed, internally consistent BackupData (>=2 accounts, >=10 transactions, >=2 categories; every transaction.accountId and categoryId references an existing entity; any splits sum to the parent amount; both income (+) and expense (-) present) and is DETERMINISTIC (fixed ids across calls). Every sample id contains the marker 'sample' so sample data can be cleanly separated/cleared from real data. SHORTCUTS is a non-empty registry of { id; keys; label } with unique ids and unique keys.

DELIVERABLE:
1. src/lib/sample/index.ts — export function buildSampleData(): BackupData (deterministic, 'sample'-marked ids, a couple months of realistic transactions incl. a split, a budget or two, optionally a scheduled item + an asset/holding/price). Also export async loaders: loadSampleData(repositories): Promise<void> (writes the sample entities via the repositories) and clearSampleData(repositories): Promise<void> (removes only the 'sample'-marked records). Keep sample data clearly separated from real records.
2. src/lib/shortcuts/index.ts — export const SHORTCUTS with a sensible set (e.g. new transaction, go to dashboard/transactions/reports, focus search, show shortcuts help) and a small matcher/handler; plus a React hook or provider (src/components/shortcuts/) that listens for keydown, matches SHORTCUTS, and runs the action (navigation via react-router, etc.), ignoring events from text inputs. Include a '?' help overlay listing the shortcuts.
3. src/components/pwa/ — a PWA update prompt using vite-plugin-pwa's virtual:pwa-register/react (useRegisterSW): when needRefresh is true, show a non-blocking 'A new version is available — Reload' prompt that calls updateServiceWorker(true). NO silent updates.
4. src/App.tsx — mount the keyboard-shortcuts provider/handler (inside the Router so it can navigate) and the PWA update prompt. Change nothing else about routing.
5. src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — when the vault is empty (no accounts yet), show a first-run ONBOARDING / getting-started guide: set base currency, add an account, import data, or load the sample dataset (with actions/links). When data exists, render the normal dashboard.
6. src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx — add controls to Load sample data and Clear sample data (calling the loaders with the session repositories, then refreshing the stores). Keep all existing Settings sections.
7. Responsive polish: ensure the main layouts (nav/sidebar, tables, forms, dashboard, reports) are usable on mobile/tablet widths using the existing Tailwind responsive utilities; do not restructure pages you don't own.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint` — all exit 0. (Do NOT loop the suite. `pnpm run build` is verified by CI.) Write real Vitest tests for buildSampleData and SHORTCUTS.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the sample-data design (+ how it's separated/cleared), the shortcut set + handler, the update-prompt wiring, the onboarding flow, and any Phase 13 follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + conventions exactly (deterministic 'sample'-marked data with referential integrity; SHORTCUTS unique ids/keys); reuse existing layers; do NOT edit db/stores/routes/Layout; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (buildSampleData is non-trivial, referentially consistent, 'sample'-marked, deterministic; SHORTCUTS is a non-empty registry with unique ids/keys). The sample + shortcuts modules exist; App mounts the shortcuts handler and a PWA update prompt (needRefresh -> reload, no silent update); SettingsPage can load/clear sample data; the Dashboard shows first-run onboarding. The Phase 10b/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint pass (build in CI). Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
